name: Orca runtime
description: Runs the container's own headless Orca runtime (orca serve), installing and updating Orca in the user's home on every start, so a new Orca release takes a restart rather than an image rebuild.

version.description: Orca version to run. 'latest' tracks GitHub releases, which is what the desktop app auto-updates to; pin one (say 1.4.229) to hold it. ORCA_VERSION overrides it at runtime.

port.description: Port the runtime listens on inside the container. ORCA_SERVE_PORT overrides it at runtime.

pairingAddress.description: Address clients reach the runtime at, advertised in pairing offers. Empty uses TS_HOSTNAME (a Foreman environment's tailnet name), else 127.0.0.1. ORCA_PAIRING_ADDRESS overrides it at runtime.
